title: Claude Agent SDK
description: Expose SerpApi search to Claude through an in-process SDK MCP server.
---

# Claude Agent SDK

Claude Agent SDK accepts custom tools through an SDK MCP server. Everything in
this example runs in one Python process; you do not need a separate MCP service.

## Install

```bash
pip install "serpapi-search-tools[claude-agent-sdk]"
```

If Claude Agent SDK is already installed in your project, use
`pip install serpapi-search-tools` instead.

```bash
export SERPAPI_API_KEY="your-serpapi-key"
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="your-anthropic-key"
```

## Run it

```python
import asyncio

from claude_agent_sdk import ClaudeAgentOptions, create_sdk_mcp_server, query
from serpapi_search_tools import news_search, web_search


async def main():
    server = create_sdk_mcp_server(
        name="serpapi",
        version="1.0.0",
        tools=[
            web_search(),
            news_search(),
        ],
    )
    options = ClaudeAgentOptions(
        model="claude-sonnet-5",
        mcp_servers={"serpapi": server},
        allowed_tools=["mcp__serpapi__web_search", "mcp__serpapi__news_search"],
        max_turns=6,
    )
    async for message in query(
        prompt="Find three recent portable solar generator stories.",
        options=options,
    ):
        if getattr(message, "result", None):
            print(message.result)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Try it

Ask Claude to find three recent portable solar generator stories and summarize
what changed.

## Customize the search

```python
current_news = news_search(
    default_params={"hl": "en", "gl": "us"},
    result_limit=3,
    name="current_news",
)
```

When you change the name, add the corresponding MCP id to `allowed_tools`.
`current_news` becomes `mcp__serpapi__current_news`.
